title: privacyassay-summary/1.0
description: On-device browser-fingerprint benchmark result. Two producers write this schema id: the CLI runner bin/privacyassay.mjs, and the in-page Save-summary button. They agree on schema, score, grade, verdict, randomizer, crossSite and note, but each adds its own fields, and the in-page file uses friendlier names for three of them: cappedBy is the CLI's strongest, topLeaks is its exposedStrong, and counts.readingsTotal is its readingsTotal, but counts.readingsHidden is the COMPLEMENT of shownCount, not the same number: readingsHidden equals readingsTotal minus shownCount. Reading one as the other inverts it. Both sets are described below, so read defensively rather than assuming the CLI vocabulary. Nothing in this document leaves the machine unless a human chooses to share it.

version.description: PRIORS catalog version the score was computed against

score.description: Share of the scored surfaces the browser hides. Higher is more private.

randomizer.description: True if the browser randomizes per site; then the single-site score is exposure on one page, not a grade

crossSite.description: Two-origin cross-site result, or null when it was not obtained. Both producers populate it: the in-page two-origin test, and the CLI, which serves 127.0.0.1 and localhost from one handler and waits for the page to finish the comparison. A null here is never a zero - it means not measurable, and crossSiteNote says why.

crossSiteNote.description: CLI only, and only when crossSite is null: why the two-origin figure is absent (the page's own failure text, "not measurable", or "skipped (--no-cross)").

runs.description: Number of runs when --runs N>1; the reported score is the median

generated.description: In-page only: ISO 8601 timestamp of the run

browser.description: In-page only: the browser and add-ons the tool identified, or 'not identified'

cappedBy.description: In-page only: the heaviest reading still shown. Same value the CLI calls 'strongest'

topLeaks.description: In-page only: strong readings still shown. Same value the CLI calls 'exposedStrong'

handedOver.description: In-page only: every shown surface, heaviest first

counts.description: In-page only: reading tallies, all five counting READINGS not categories. readingsTotal is the CLI's readingsTotal. readingsHidden is the COMPLEMENT of the CLI's shownCount: readingsHidden = readingsTotal - shownCount, and readingsHidden = masked + notReadable. Reading one as the other inverts it.
